confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Japanese pricing, with Naha treated as a lower-cost regional city than Tokyo or Osaka. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with July peak-season demand and is the least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer pricing in Japanese izakaya and bars, not sourced from current listings. No live pages were inspected. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA table and was not verified by opening the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is a regional Japanese city with a summer tourism peak (Okinawa Prefecture), priced below Tokyo and Osaka for restaurants and accommodation, with an adjustment for July demand on hotels and hostels.
